objective: Implement the retry loop with exponential backoff in app/notify.py per frozen contract C1 (3 attempts; delays 1s then 2s, cap 30s; retryable = 429 + 5xx; any other 4xx fails immediately; delay callable injectable) while keeping the record shape C2 with attempts = number of provider calls made, and add tests/test_retry.py proving acceptance A1-A4 against fake provider clients.

concepts: injectable delay callable (no real sleep in tests)

inputs: frozen contracts C1 (retry policy), C2 (record shape), C3 (provider interface) — inlined in this package
existing suite tests/test_notify.py + tests/test_gateway_observed.py (must stay green, unmodified)

frozen_contracts.spec: Retry policy (single source of truth, consumed by implementation and by tests): MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; delays before attempt 2 and 3 are 1s and 2s (exponential base 1s, cap 30s); retryable statuses = {429} union [500..599]; non-retryable = any other 4xx (fail immediately on first response); a 2xx/3xx response always succeeds immediately. Delays must be injectable (a delay callable passed to the retry helper, defaulting to time.sleep) so tests never sleep for real.

Notification record shape (unchanged keys): {user_id: str, template: str, status: 'sent'|'failed', provider_ref: str|None, error: str|None, attempts: int 1..3, created_at: int epoch}. `attempts` = number of ProviderClient.send calls actually made. provider_ref taken from the final successful response; error from the final failed response (or None).

ProviderClient.send(payload: dict) -> ProviderResponse interface is FROZEN and unchanged: payload {'to','template','vars'}; response is ProviderResponse(status:int, body:dict, headers:dict). The gateway's success shape is 202 {'accepted': true, 'provider_ref': ...}; failure 4xx/5xx {'error': str} (429 observed without Retry-After).

non_goals: no changes to app/provider.py (frozen interface), app/db.py, or app/api.py
no bulk-send API, no retry-storm / backpressure mitigation (stage out-of-scope)
no real time.sleep in tests — the delay callable is always injected in the test path
implementation_constraints: stdlib only; plain unittest (the repo has no pytest)
send_notification's public signature is unchanged; retry wraps ProviderClient.send inside the service
delay callable parameter (default time.sleep) on the retry helper so tests record delays without sleeping
update app/notify.py's module docstring (currently 'No retry today') to describe the retry behavior
exactly one store.put per send_notification call, after the retry window resolves

deliverables.what: retry loop with backoff per C1, record per C2 with meaningful attempts
unit tests for A1-A4 (transient recovery, mixed 4xx stop, permanent failure, 429 retry/exhaust, injected schedule)

acceptance_tests.description: provider 500,500,202 -> record status 'sent', attempts 3, provider_ref from the 202 body
provider 500,400 -> record 'failed', attempts 2 (4xx stops the loop immediately)
provider always 500 -> record 'failed', attempts 3, error from the last response; no exception escapes
provider always 400 -> record 'failed', attempts 1, exactly one provider call
provider 429 then 202 -> record 'sent', attempts 2, exactly one backoff delay (1.0) recorded by the injected fake
3-attempt failure records delay calls [1.0, 2.0] exactly (schedule per C1, cap 30s not exceeded)

failure_cases.scenario: final failed response body has no 'error' key
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record.error is None, status 'failed' (C2: error from the final failed response or None)
the retry aborts immediately; record 'failed' with error naming the delay failure; no further provider calls

failure_cases.scenario: T01's verification verdict is FALSIFIED — this task has no dependency on T01's output (it runs in parallel against frozen C1/C3); the verdict is checked only at the T03 integration gate, so the executor must not pause or wait for T01
failure_cases.expected_behavior: T03 raises a request_contract_revision blocker before anything ships; this task's 429 branch becomes the replan target — the accepted cost of the parallel design (C1/C3 frozen)

handoff.notes: attempts is now 1..3 (was always 1); T03's E1 counts provider .calls and E2 asserts one record per call — both rely on the retry loop not writing intermediate records.
